headline: Zelensky confirms Ukraine attacked a Russian vessel in the Gulf of Finland; Norway calls for caution
summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy confirmed his country was responsible for a drone attack on a Russian cargo ship in the Gulf of Finland. Norway called for caution.
why: Attacks on shipping in the Baltic region affect maritime trade routes and insurance costs, and they add to geopolitical risk for Europe and Russia.
original_headline: Zelenski confirma que Ucrania atacó un buque ruso en el golfo de Finlandia; Noruega pide prudencia
